tasks.label: close-running-app
tasks.detail: 이 저장소 bin에서 실행 중인 AdlibComposer를 닫는다 (DLL 잠금으로 빌드가 실패하지 않도록)
args: $bin = Join-Path '${workspaceFolder}' 'src\AdlibComposer.App\bin'; Get-Process AdlibComposer -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Path -and $_.Path.StartsWith($bin, [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) } | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ('closing AdlibComposer pid ' + $_.Id); $_.CloseMainWindow() | Out-Null; if (-not $_.WaitForExit(15000)) { Write-Host 'AdlibComposer is still open (unsaved changes?). Close it, then press F5 again.' } }; exit 0
